items.text: Build the BSP of the Qualcomm platform and flash it into the manufactured board.
Write documents, report issues, and communicate with the platform vendor.
Work with platform vendor for feature development, including:
Write testing programs for the required features.
Setup BSP-compiling HW and SW environment.
Build standard tests for the BSP.
Conclude some specs of each component for the next board.
Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers, and communication.
Work with platform vendors to develop BSP, platform frameworks, and embedded Linux applications using C/C++.
Work with electrical and mechanical engineers to design and manufacture embedded Linux devices.
Work with software engineers to design and implement features such as camera control, BT audio, etc.

description.text:
Key Responsibilities:
• Build the BSP of the Qualcomm platform and flash it into the manufactured board.
• Write documents, report issues, and communicate with the platform vendor.
• Work with platform vendor for feature development, including:
MIPI camera/ ISP/ USB-UVC/ USB-Audio/ BT (A2DP, AVRCP, HSP, etc.)/ Wifi connectivity/ UART/ I2C/ GPIO.
• Write testing programs for the required features.
• Setup BSP-compiling HW and SW environment.
• Setup SOP for platform development.
• Build standard tests for the BSP.
• Conclude some specs of each component for the next board.
• Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers, and communication.
• Performance management and optimization.
• Work with platform vendors to develop BSP, platform frameworks, and embedded Linux applications using C/C++.
• Work with electrical and mechanical engineers to design and manufacture embedded Linux devices.
• Work with software engineers to design and implement features such as camera control, BT audio, etc.

key_values.label: 語文條件
key_values.text: 英文：中等、中等、中等、中等

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Background:
• 2+ years' Software Engineering experience in the following: device driver development, embedded systems, or Linux kernel build system and configuration management experience.
• 2+ years of full-time system software development for Linux-based platform.
• 2+ years’experience working on systems software in a large-scale C/C++ code base.
• Experience with Software Development processes, including Git revision control best practices, bug tracking, and design documentation.
• Familiar with Bash scripts and Python.
••••••••••••
Skills:
• System software debugging, tracing, and analysis tools, such as perf, ftrace, etc.
• Experience in hardware interfaces like ADC, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc.
• Experience in the following areas: Camera Drivers, SoC BSP, Operating Systems, Bootloader.
• Experience with 64-bit ARM processors.
••••••••••••
Desired Traits
• Great knowledge of modern operating systems and computer architecture.
• Good communication & documentation skills.
• Self-motivated individual with strong problem-solving skills and a growth mindset.
